cards.title: Want to use AICA? Here's how.
cards.body: AICA Patient, AICA Doctor and AICA Pharmacy are live on Google Play for Android. Pilots are running in Lucknow.

cards.title: Families: get AICA Patient
cards.body: Search "AICA Patient" on Google Play, or tap the button on aicaglobal.in. It's for Android phones.

cards.title: Add the people you care for
cards.body: Add Mummy, Papa or grandparents as family members. Each gets their own prescriptions and reminders.

cards.title: Doctors: get AICA Doctor
cards.body: AICA Doctor is on Google Play too. It needs a clinic login, so contact the AICA team to get one.

cards.title: Chemists: get AICA Pharmacy
cards.body: AICA Pharmacy is on Google Play too. It needs a pharmacy login, and founding pharmacies in Lucknow use it free during the pilot.

cards.title: Your data is respected from sign-up
cards.body: Consent is asked at sign-up, your data is never sold, and you can download or delete it.

cards.title: Early users shape what gets built
cards.body: Tell us what works and what doesn't. It all starts at aicaglobal.in.

takeaway: Families get AICA Patient, doctors get AICA Doctor and chemists get AICA Pharmacy, all on Google Play. iPhone users can join the waitlist.
share: AICA Patient, Doctor and Pharmacy are on Google Play. aicaglobal.in
